name: traileo
description: Read and act on traileo feedback — recorded observations about web pages (a defect, a UX or copy note) with the evidence somebody captured: DOM, video, steps, network, console and screenshots.

interface.longDescription: traileo records an observation about a web page — a defect, a UX or design suggestion, a copy or accessibility note — together with the evidence captured with it: the page itself, a video, the steps, network and console activity, and screenshots. This plugin connects the agent to the traileo MCP server as the signed-in user, so it can read a feedback and its evidence, comment on it, triage and assign it, file a new one, and manage the projects and workspaces that hold them — refused exactly where the traileo web app would refuse that user.
capabilities: Read a feedback and the evidence recorded with it
Comment on, triage and assign feedback
File a new feedback with images and captures
Manage projects, labels, sites and access rules
defaultPrompt: What are the newest open feedbacks in my traileo project?

positive.prompt: Which traileo projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the projects the signed-in user can reach, with their workspace.

positive.prompt: Show me the newest feedback in my Demo Shop project on traileo.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the project, then lists its feedback newest first with title, status and author.

positive.description: Read one feedback and its evidence
positive.prompt: Open the traileo feedback about the checkout button and tell me what went wrong.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the feedback with its recorded evidence (steps, console, network) and summarises the problem.

positive.prompt: Which traileo feedbacks are assigned to me?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the feedback assigned to the signed-in user across projects.

positive.prompt: Add a comment on that traileo feedback saying the fix is in review.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the comment as the signed-in user and confirms it was posted.
